verdict.rationale: React's source is publicly hosted on GitHub at facebook/react, and community discussion confirms it was relicensed from BSD+Patents to MIT. One developer also describes reading the React source directly. Debate over the missing explicit patent grant does not undercut that the code is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: a first-party license statement (e.g. a LICENSE file or docs citation) in the evidence, and documentation that guides users through reading or navigating the source.
